model.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="tokens-assets-jobs-prd-us"} | json | event="logo_sync" | synced = 0 | failed >= 5 [1h])) or on() vector(0)

annotations.summary: tokens-assets: logo-sync published nothing on ≥2 runs in the last hour
annotations.description: Counts {"event":"logo_sync"} run summaries where every attempted mint failed and the batch was non-trivial (synced=0, failed>=5; 7d of prod logs show 1-2 candidate runs routinely fail outright on a single dead URL, while real incidents fail 5-200) — the same condition that makes POST /jobs/logo-sync answer 5xx; per-mint fetch failures never fail the batch. Two or more in an hour (Scheduler retries once) means the job cannot publish anything: check GCS_LOGO_BUCKET / bucket IAM, the mint_logos table (migration 0023/0024), and the worker logs. Caveat: a handler crash before the summary emits no logo_sync line and is not counted here (Cloud Run request logs are not shipped to this Loki tenant). Per-URL fetch noise (404s, redirects, blocked IPFS gateways) is expected and deliberately excluded from the provider error-rate rules.
